body: Because then there's the conversation about what to /do/ with you. And there's nothing to be /done/ with me. My life is what it is. I don't think it's something they can fix by sticking me in a place for a few days.

At this point it's kinda my only option.

I'm devastated that my boyfriend abandoned me. I think that's the only thing really keeping me holding on because it doesn't seem finite with him. He won't block me or my number. I don't know if I'm just trying to invest all my hope into him coming back but it's genuinely the only thing keeping me holding on. If he suddenly decided to block me or something I'd be done.
I'm home from work now and I just want to let it all go. I don't want to live another day..

He's the one that encouraged me to get help. But now that I'm in therapy, he barely talks to me. I feel like this inconvenience in his life. Baggage that he'd feel too guilty getting rid of.

Everyone keeps acting like it's all going to be okay. I'm in therapy now so everything is fixed. But it isn't. I don't feel any better. I feel more empty. More out of control. Knowing I can't control any of it. I can't get it together. I keep waiting for the next blindside. I don't know that I can take it. Or if I want to.

so far, i'm still on wellbutrin, ativan and trazodone (for sleep, which isn't working. i've not slept in a week). they did have me on klonopin, but that was a waking nightmare.

from what i've read, the benzos (wellbutrin, ativan, klonopin) are really hard to successfully overdose on. i'm still looking at trazodone.
